headline: Rosebank Oil Field Faces Political Scrutiny in UK Over Future Development
summary: The undeveloped Rosebank offshore oil field in the North Sea remains at the center of political debate regarding UK energy security and future licensing commitments.
why: Rosebank is one of the largest undeveloped oil fields on the UK continental shelf, representing a focal asset in North Sea upstream investment and energy policy.

impacts.name: Oil & Gas Upstream
impacts.why: Political debate over offshore licensing introduces operational and regulatory uncertainty for North Sea projects.
